stem_book: The following diagram represents the (p – V) changes of a gas. Thus, total work done is (a) p₂(V₂ − V₁) + p₃(V₃ − V₂) (b) p₁(V₂ − V₁) + p₃(V₃ − V₂) (c) p₂(V₃ − V₁) + p₃(V₂ − V₁) (d) p₂(V₃ − V₂) + p₃(V₂ − V₁)
work: isochoric drops do no work; area under the two isobars = p₂(V₂−V₁) + p₃(V₃−V₂)
